related.title: Docker Hub
related.description: It is the cloud repository service used by me to storage my Docker Containers. Each them have themselves repository and classification, based in version and "container base" (Debian; Alpine; ...). The source code of all them are available in my GitHub/Gitlab, and it can be accessed through of the overview section of the Docker Hub repository of the respective containers.

related.title: GitHub
related.description: This is where I storage the source code of my Open Source projects, together with their documentation, presentation, wiki, and other things related with them. I also use this platform to help other developers, with their Open Source projects, and to fork other projects - to modify them based my ideas.

related.title: GitLab
related.description: This is other cloud repository service, similar to GitHub. It is possible to storage projects source code, to collaborate with other users (in specific projects), and, mainly, to run DevOps pipelines (platform focus). This account was created to be a mirror of my GitHub account (because of N problems with GitHub), but, after that I discover some of its amazing resource, I decide to use it to other things, like to host the "online branch" of the DuckAfire's Nest.

related.title: itch.io
related.description: Yes, I start as a developer to be a Game Developer! I think that a lot of other developers were like me: an young with the dream to create a(n) (indie) game. Sadly I grew and I discovered that the world is not a "morango". But I still have some ideas of games; because of this, and because I already published ONE (incompleted) GAME, I created this account to allow that you can download the games created by me of an easy way.

related.title: NPM Registry
related.description: The "pattern" platform to storage CSS and (mainly) JavaScript packages. There, in my account, you can found all of my packages that have as focus the WEB development. The back-end packages can be donwloaded using CLIs (NPM; Yarn; ...) that can access the NPM Registry, and the front-end packages can be required using a CDN service (all front-end projects have a jsDelivr link, to request their content via URL). Projects source files available there are minimal (only necessary files), so, to see all them, it is neceesary access my GitHub/GitLab.

related.title: Tic80
related.description: What is this platform that do not have a branch icon in Font Awesome? This is the Tic80 Tiny Computer, alias Tic80, a fantasy computer to create tiny games. YES! I started to program with this - it was a long time. I really love it, mainly because it taught me to like of Lua - my favorite programming language. Tiny games and tools, related with Tic80, can be found here.

related.title: Rinha de Backend 2025
related.description: This project was created as a way to participate in the yearly event Rinha de Backend (edition 2025), a community competition to create a backend in any programming language and with any technologies to resolve a determined problem. Sadly, this project cannot participate of the competition, but it will be finished. The main goal is to learn - but win is cool!

related.title: todo-list
related.description: This project has as aim to available a safe, easy, and fast way to manager to do lists through the use of a terminal cli. Python was chosen as base language to this project because of its alignment to the proposal of it (what they already were cited) and because of the high portability of the language between different Operational System. The code of this project aims to align it to the main conventions disseminated by the community of that programming language, in order to welcome possible contributors that can collaborate to the evolution of this project.
